title: Multi-region switchover simulation and cluster recovery automation for Private VPCs
creator: Ayesha Kumar
description:
Objective: Build automated, safe, and repeatable multi-region switchover simulations for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. The goal is to validate failover procedures, Terraform IaC correctness, and recovery playbooks with minimal risk to production-like environments. Scope covers: Terraform modules for cross-region resources, automated health checks for control-plane and data-plane components, a scheduled drill runner that executes an orchestrated switchover, and runbook + dashboard updates.

Why: Several enterprise customers require periodic DR testing and evidence of recovery exercises. Currently we have ad-hoc runbooks and manual steps for region switchover; this work aims to codify the safe sequence, provide tooling to exercise it in preprod/private-sandbox accounts, and capture metrics for post-mortem and compliance.

Non-goals: This ticket does not change production DNS TTLs or perform live failovers for paying customer clusters. Those actions will be gated behind manual approvals in a separate ops runbook once automated drills prove safe in sandbox environments.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules updated to expose explicit cross-region linkages (transit gateway attachments, peering, region-aware load balancer configs) and validated by automated plan/apply in sandbox accounts
A drill-runner job that can be scheduled and run on-demand (GitHub Actions / Step Functions) to perform a simulated switchover without modifying customer-facing DNS records
Health-check suite added that validates: control-plane API responses, worker heartbeat stream, inference runtime process health, KV cache warmup and prefix-replay, and backend storage connectivity
Canary traffic flow executed post-switchover to confirm routing and model inference correctness (synthetic traces with pass/fail thresholds), with automatic rollback trigger on failure

Runbook and Console dashboard pages updated to show drill status, key metrics, and a post-drill checklist. Evidence artifacts (logs, plan outputs, verification screenshots) are stored in the DR bucket for audits
tasks: Design Terraform changes: add region-aware variables, output cross-region resource IDs, parametrize peering/TransitGateway attachments
Create a 'drill-runner' workflow (GH Actions) that executes terraform plan/apply in sandbox and runs the health-check suite
Implement health-check microservice (lightweight Lambda/ECS task) to run probes against control-plane endpoints, inference endpoints, and KV cache state
Add automated DNS/proxy staging: lower TTLs in sandbox and create a traffic-shift mechanism (NLB target group switch or route table swap) that can be toggled by the drill-runner
Instrument Console: dashboard tile for drill progress, SLOs and automated comparison of pre/post latency/cost metrics
Update Private runbook with step-by-step recovery steps, triage checklist, and escalation contacts
Safety gating: add a manual approval step and a 'dry-run' mode that performs every validation without changing routing
End-to-end test: run two sandbox drills (one planned low-impact, one full switch) and collect artifacts for the post-mortem
